summary: Invech Holdings disclosed a change of control via 8-K. On July 17, 2026, majority shareholder Alexander M. Woods-Leo sold 88,000,000 common shares and 300,000 Series A preferred shares to Stephen Ken Adair for $290,000, representing ~75.9% of common stock and 100% of preferred, about 80% voting power. Simultaneously, the company divested its Paragon Assets (paragonrentals.ai SaaS platform) to Paragon Rentals, Inc., controlled by Woods-Leo, for nominal consideration, as a condition to closing. The transaction may affect shell company status. Board authorized the divestiture; no advisors named. Watch for post-closing financing or reverse merger activities.
